title: Attrition Clause Terms by Block Type — Group Room Blocks Contract
content:
The attrition clause of a Group Room Blocks contract is set per block type by seven terms: the share of contracted room nights the group may fall short of without attrition (the attrition allowance), the share of the lost room revenue charged as attrition, what lost room revenue is computed on, how pickup is compared with the commitment, whether room tax is added, whether rooms the hotel resold reduce the shortfall, and the calendar days after the departure date by which attrition is assessed.

| Block type | Attrition allowance (% of contracted room nights) | Share of lost room revenue charged (%) | Assessed by (calendar days after departure) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 20 | 100 | 30 |
| Wedding Room Block | 20 | 100 | 30 |
| Sports Team Room Block | 25 | 80 | 30 |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 10 | 100 | 30 |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 15 | 90 | 30 |
| Association Convention Room Block | 20 | 80 | 30 |

Terms common to all six block types:

| Term | Setting |
|---|---|
| Lost room revenue is computed on | the shortfall room nights times the group rate |
| Pickup is compared with the commitment on | cumulative room nights over the block |
| Room tax added to attrition | No |
| Resold rooms reduce the shortfall | No |

### Reading the allowance (hypothetical contract)

On a block contracted for 400 room nights, an allowance of 25 percent lets the group fall short by up to 100 room nights without attrition; an allowance of 10 percent lets it fall short by up to 40.
